outcome: Prognostic assessment of fetal hydronephrosis severity
cohort: Pregnant women with a gestational age of > 30 weeks whose fetus was suspected of hydronephrosis.
finding: The hydronephrosis index (HI) correlated negatively with pelvic AP diameter and positively with parenchymal thickness, showing a significant correlation with parenchymal thickness in the diagnosis and prognostic assessment of fetal hydronephrosis at all follow-up stages.
